st-qa-money-se-005.text: To get a refund check payable to you and your former roommate, you will need to coordinate with the provider to specify both recipients. You should ensure the check is mailed to the correct addresses, and both of you should sign and date the check. If the provider allows, you can arrange for the check to be split or sent separately.

st-qa-money-se-012.text: No, earning a couple of pounds over the higher-rate threshold does not double your total income tax bill. The higher-rate threshold affects only the amount of tax paid on income above a certain level, but additional income beyond that threshold is taxed at the standard rate, not at double.

st-qa-money-se-013.text: No, the expense ratio of a target-date fund is typically charged on the underlying mutual funds it holds, not on top of them. The fund's total expense ratio includes all associated costs.
